I believe this should use `TTRN` with plural forms for translation, it won't work correctly in languages with different plural form configurations than English

This was copypasted from [L907-L911](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123149/changes/BASE..8ea81b708ca41c7248ecb55013b1de7ad886117a#diff-34d38f81731bbe269a0a23d64b08a105306056d82db9e7b662748b38a924da9bR907-R911) so i guess we should update both

The plural variation has only 1 `%d` argument which is the counting, so i think there's no risk on ordering words, it just has to have the number somewhere
Where is the original string translated? The string needs to be marked for translation in order for it to be actually available, it needs to be extracted
